epic.title: Timetable Management Module
epic.body: Provides a comprehensive system for administrators to design, manage, and publish class-wise and teacher-wise schedules, ensuring optimized resource utilization across subjects, rooms, and staff.

features.title: Timetable Configuration & Management
features.body: Admin interface to create and modify weekly schedules for different classes, including period timings, subject assignments, and room allocations.

stories.title: Manage and View Timetables (Admin CRUD)
stories.body: As an admin, I want to create, view, update, and delete timetable records for various classes so that I can maintain an up-to-date school schedule.
acceptanceCriteria: Create: Admin can add new periods using a 'Plus' action and a dedicated dialog.
List: View a list of classes and their respective weekly or daily schedules.
Update: Admin can edit existing period details like subject, teacher, and room via an 'Edit' action.
Delete: Admin can remove periods from the schedule using a 'Trash' action.
Search/Filter: Ability to filter schedules by class name and day.

stories.title: Manage Timetable Periods (Backend)
stories.body: API endpoints to persist and manage individual periods or breaks within a class schedule.
acceptanceCriteria: POST endpoint to create a period with subject, teacher ID, room ID, and time range.
PUT/PATCH endpoint to update existing period details.
DELETE endpoint to remove a period with soft-delete support.
Supports marking a slot as a 'BREAK' or 'Free Period'.

features.title: Scheduling Logic & Constraints
features.body: Backend logic and frontend validations to ensure no overlaps and valid resource mapping for teachers and rooms.

stories.title: Teacher and Room Conflict Validation
stories.body: Validate that a teacher or a room is not double-booked for the same time slot across different classes.
acceptanceCriteria: Prevent saving if the teacher is already assigned to another class at that time.
Prevent saving if the room is already occupied during the selected slot.
Validation must check for time overlaps, not just exact matches.

stories.title: Room Type and Subject Compatibility
stories.body: Ensure subjects requiring specific facilities (like Labs) are assigned to the correct room types.
acceptanceCriteria: Flag a warning if a Lab-based subject is assigned to a standard classroom.
